title: Check free and used system memory
summary: Use the `free` command to see how much RAM your computer is using and how much is still available. It shows total, used, and free memory, plus swap space.

steps.explain: Run the `free` command to display the current memory usage in kilobytes.
steps.expect: A table showing total, used, and free memory for RAM and swap.

alternatives.explain: Display memory in human-readable units (e.g., GiB, MiB) instead of raw kilobytes.
